title: Elastic scaling and dynamic mid-run recruitment
output_schema: command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json profile=council-participants-module (required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])
question_or_target: Implement tools/council/participants/elastic.py so seat count grows within min/max when coverage or expertise gaps are detected mid-run. Falsifiable question: does a recruited participant receive the same information partition as an original seat, or does it inherit the existing consensus and therefore add no independence?
answer: A recruit receives the original shared partition (question, shared evidence, catch-up facts) and not the running consensus. context_diff.partition_match is true on the honest path. Feeding the consensus transcript is the planted-bad fixture: independence_check status=FIRE. SUCCESS:IMP-0274

evidence.claim: A recruited seat and an original seat share question, shared_evidence, catch_up_facts, and partition_id; the recruit does not gain consensus keys.

independence_check compares the recruit's first output to the running consensus and FIRES when the briefing contained that consensus (output Jaccard 1.0 on the planted-bad fixture; SILENT on the honest partition, Jaccard ~0.07).

negative_controls.description: Feed the recruit the running consensus transcript. independence_check must FIRE. The same check is SILENT when the recruit receives only the original information partition.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0265 registry.py is a catalog dependency and is not imported. elastic.py accepts seat dicts with identity/expertise fields.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-run after IMP-0265 lands and pass registry seats through recruit().

residual_unknowns.claim: First-output independence on live LLM tokens is not measured. This unit's check is mechanical: context leak plus first-output echo against a fixture consensus string.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Seat a live recruit with a withheld consensus and score first-round correlation against the standing majority.
